newsitem.title: MEXICO: Chartwell and Piasa plan Mexico joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Chartwell and Piasa plan Mexico joint venture.

text.p: Grupo Piasa and Chartwell Leisure Corp said on Wednesday they have agreed to jointly invest $114 million in developing 30 hotels in Mexico over the next five years.
Grupo Piasa is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Grupo Acerero de Norte (GAN), The joint venture will be known as Chartwell de Mexico.

"Chartwell de Mexico's shareholding breakdown is 50/50 for each partner, and the $114 million investment is on the same 50/50 basis. The plan is to invest over the next five years," company spokesman Luis Audifred told Reuters.
Chartwell plans to grant franchises to operate the hotels under the names Travelodge and Wingate. Each hotel will have an average of 100 rooms, with a planned total of 3,000 rooms.
